description:
**What:** Add end-to-end handler tests for all three gaps fixed in T1-T3 via register_tasks_handlers dispatching.

**Tests:**
1. isDraft_revert_via_dispatcher: Task/set update {"isDraft":true} on task with isDraft=false → notUpdated["t1"]["type"]=="invalidProperties" and properties==["isDraft"]. Oracle: §4.
2. isDraft_draft_to_publish_allowed: Task/set update {"isDraft":false} on draft task → reaches MockBackend (not pre-rejected by handler).
3. utcStart_not_in_default_properties: Task/get without requesting utcStart → returned task JSON has no utcStart key.
4. utcStart_returned_when_requested: Task/get with properties:["id","utcStart"] → returned task has utcStart field (MockBackend compute returns fixed value).
5. per_user_patch_split: Task/set update {"color":"#ff0000"} → update_task_per_user called (verify via mock call tracking).

MockBackend extended to track which update method was called.

**Acceptance criteria:** All 5 tests pass. cargo test -p jmap-tasks-server exits 0.
